name: Hay Sell Stand
summary: The selling destination is marked SELL HAY. Demo V8 added snapping to its conveyor connection. A needle sold inside a hay product returns to the pile, according to the developer.
version: Demo V8 announcement (September 11, 2026); follow your installed build’s prompts

data.operation: Use the connection at the stand rather than stopping the belt nearby. If placement does not snap, check whether F has enabled No Snap Mode.
data.check: Trace the last incoming branches back to scanning. The developer describes normal needle recycling, not a universal recovery guarantee for a missing-needle bug.

sources.label: Developer reply and player reports · September 13, 2026

imageAlt: Conveyor carrying hay toward the stall marked SELL HAY.
imageCaption: The belt meets the front of the SELL HAY stand. Use this to identify the destination; the screenshot’s prices are not current price references. Official Steam screenshot.
